fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-03-20 (afternoon, 13:25): The proprietor of Kurinji Stationery noticed missing stock (garments) valued at Rs. 25,000 near Kaveri Park Bus Stand Area in Trichy. Contact details given by the complainant, Harish Mani, include the number 9000000132. The complainant is associated with the business Kurinji Stationery. The complaint refers to Jeeva Muthu, a relative of the suspect, reachable on 9000000124. Siva Sekar (9000000284) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Missing stock noticed at closing time and a review of shop CCTV was requested.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, CCTV, bus stand, documents, afternoon, associate, witness
